semiconductor_relevance: High — Summit Super Abrasive specializes in industrial diamond abrasives and slurries that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Summit Super Abrasive provides a range of industrial diamond abrasives, CBN abrasives, and CMP slurries tailored for semiconductor applications. Their products are designed to enhance polishing processes and can be customized to meet specific customer requirements.
capabilities: Industrial diamond abrasives (single crystal, polycrystalline, RCD-type)
